summary: # Difficult Conversation Framework Complete guide to the three-phase framework for challenging workplace conversations. ## The Three Phases in Depth ### Phase 1: Preparation (40% of Success) Most difficult conversations fail before they start. Thorough preparation dramatically improves outcomes. #### Step 1: Clarify the Facts ##### What happened? (Objective) Write down only observable facts: - What did you see or hear? - When and where did it happen?
